body:
A look at recent urgent care services transactions from the likes of Goldman Sachs, Shore Capital and NewSpring Capital Partners; Trivest Partners portfolio company Wheelhouse acquires All Star Garage Door; They Said It: pulling from our Sector Spotlight on the TMT industry.

Michael Fosnaugh, senior managing director and co-head of flagship fund, Vista Equity Partners, features in They Said It.

p: Goldman Sachs, Shore Capital, NewSpring Capital Partners 등의 최근 응급 치료 서비스 관련 거래 동향; Trivest Partners 포트폴리오사인 Wheelhouse가 All Star Garage Door 인수; They Said It: TMT 산업 섹터 스포트라이트 조명.
Vista Equity Partners의 선임managing director이자 플래그십 펀드 공동 대표인 Michael Fosnaugh가 They Said It 코너에 등장합니다.
